source_catalogue.relationship: Representative exercise IDs point to the existing text-only catalogue; the atlas does not copy or add third-party media.

content_boundary: Educational movement coverage only; no automatic dose, medical suitability decision, best-exercise ranking, or individual outcome promise.
excluded_scope: exercise rankings based only on acute EMG
sets, repetitions, load, frequency and progression

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Pectoralis major as the primary hypertrophy region; pectoralis minor is not separately programmed.
primary_joint_actions: shoulder flexion/adduction depending on arm path
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 用推类动作承担主要复合覆盖，用夹胸类动作补充单关节肩水平内收；不把上胸、下胸写成可被完全隔离的独立肌肉。
muscle_regions.limitations: Bench angle and arm path may change regional emphasis, but the atlas does not quantify regional growth or rank one variation as universally superior.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Latissimus dorsi within the broader back region.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 垂直拉是主要动作家族，水平拉也可覆盖背阔肌；握法和拉向只记录为变式，不据此承诺局部增长。
muscle_regions.limitations: Back exercises involve several muscles simultaneously; catalogue target labels are not direct measurements of individual muscle stimulus.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Rhomboids, middle trapezius and other scapular retractors grouped for programming coverage.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 以水平拉覆盖肩胛后缩，再用后肩类动作补充肩水平外展；这是训练覆盖分组，不是单块肌肉的精确剂量。
muscle_regions.limitations: The grouping simplifies several muscles with different roles and does not diagnose scapular mechanics.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Upper, middle and lower trapezius are acknowledged; direct shrug coverage mainly reflects scapular elevation.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 耸肩类主要记录肩胛上提覆盖，划船类提供部分肩胛后缩覆盖；不把一个动作标成完整覆盖斜方肌全部区域。
muscle_regions.limitations: Regional trapezius emphasis is not quantified by this atlas.

muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 肩上推承担直接复合覆盖，卧推类也会形成协同覆盖；避免把所有推举组数重复计算为同等直接组数。
muscle_regions.limitations: Contribution varies with technique and arm path; the atlas does not calculate fractional set credit.

muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 侧平举类提供更直接的肩外展覆盖，肩上推作为复合协同覆盖；两类动作不是完全等价替代。
muscle_regions.limitations: The atlas describes plausible coverage, not measured regional hypertrophy for every variation.

muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 后肩飞鸟或后束划船提供更直接覆盖，普通水平拉提供协同覆盖；不依据动作名称推断精确刺激。
muscle_regions.limitations: Technique can shift work toward upper-back muscles; no individual activation measurement is available.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Biceps brachii, brachialis and brachioradialis grouped for practical exercise coverage.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 弯举类提供直接覆盖，拉类动作提供协同覆盖；是否增加弯举取决于目标、时间和整体动作结构，而不是固定必需。
muscle_regions.limitations: Single- and multi-joint evidence is limited and does not support a universal isolation-exercise requirement.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Triceps brachii as an elbow extensor; heads are not assigned separate validated dose targets.
primary_joint_actions: shoulder extension contribution from the long head
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 臂屈伸类提供直接覆盖，推类动作提供协同覆盖；可记录过顶与非过顶变式，但不承诺某一头的精确增肌比例。
muscle_regions.limitations: Joint position can change muscle length and emphasis, but individual regional growth is not inferred.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Quadriceps femoris group; rectus femoris and vasti are not treated as interchangeable regions.
primary_joint_actions: hip flexion contribution from rectus femoris
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 深蹲、分腿动作和腿屈伸构成不同动作家族；它们可以互补，但不能仅按‘练腿’合并为一个无差别标签。
muscle_regions.limitations: Exercise setup and range of motion affect joint demands; this atlas does not prescribe depth for an individual.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Posterior-thigh knee flexors and hip extensors grouped while preserving two distinct action families.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 髋铰链和屈膝是两个不可简单互换的动作家族；只做硬拉类不等于完整覆盖屈膝功能。
muscle_regions.limitations: The atlas does not infer regional hamstring growth from one exercise name.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Gluteus maximus for hip extension plus gluteus medius/minimus contributions to frontal-plane control.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 臀肌覆盖至少分为髋伸、蹲/单腿和髋外展家族；动作选择强调互补，不用单一‘臀部最佳动作’排名。
muscle_regions.limitations: The gluteal group contains distinct muscles and regions; coverage labels do not establish individual growth distribution.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Practical frontal-plane grouping; adductors and abductors remain opposite action families.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 髋内收和外展需要分别记录；深蹲和单腿动作提供协同负荷，但不替代所有直接动作需求。
muscle_regions.limitations: This is a programming taxonomy, not a pelvic or hip clinical assessment.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Gastrocnemius and soleus grouped as plantar flexors while preserving straight- and bent-knee setup differences.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 站姿与坐姿提踵都属于跖屈家族，但膝关节位置不同；系统保留两类设置，不把它们视为完全相同。
muscle_regions.limitations: No calf-specific optimal exercise or minimum effective dose is asserted.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Abdominal wall and trunk stabilizers grouped by movement task rather than a cosmetic 'core' score.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 把躯干屈曲与抗伸展、抗旋转、抗侧屈分开记录；稳定类动作不是医学意义上的腰背康复。
muscle_regions.limitations: No pain-treatment or spinal-stability diagnosis is made from exercise categories.

muscle_regions.anatomical_scope: Wrist flexors/extensors and grip-related forearm musculature grouped for practical coverage.
muscle_regions.coverage_notes_zh: 直接腕屈伸与负重握持属于不同任务；动作库暂以腕屈伸代表直接覆盖，不把握力成绩等同于前臂增肌。
muscle_regions.limitations: Representative catalogue coverage is incomplete for loaded carries and grip devices.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 从杠铃、哑铃或自重变式中选能稳定完成并记录进步的一种；更换器械时视为新变式，不直接比较负重数字。
movement_patterns.limitations: Pressing variations do not isolate the pectorals and are not interchangeable strength tests.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 用于补充肩水平内收，不自动优先于推类动作；选择能控制动作幅度和张力的变式。
movement_patterns.limitations: The shoulder is not literally single-joint in all implementations; regional chest claims remain uncertain.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 根据器械、技术熟悉度和可控动作范围选择一种肩上推变式；机器与自由重量都可作为有效训练方式。
movement_patterns.limitations: Shoulder tolerance is not inferred from the atlas; painful pressing requires stopping and separate assessment.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 作为中束更直接的动作家族，与肩上推形成互补；系统不按器械给动作效果排名。
movement_patterns.limitations: Arm path, range and technique can alter loading; no universal best variation is claimed.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 用于补充后束和上背覆盖；保持动作定义一致后再比较训练记录。
movement_patterns.limitations: Scapular motion changes upper-back contribution, so target labels are not isolation proof.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 引体向上、下拉和辅助引体属于同一大类但负荷记录方式不同；优先选择可重复、可进阶的版本。
movement_patterns.limitations: Grip and torso position change demands; exercise names do not quantify latissimus stimulus.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 根据躯干支撑、器械和可重复性选择划船变式；更换支撑方式时不要把重量直接横向比较。
movement_patterns.limitations: This broad family covers several muscles and cannot assign exact set credit to each region.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 耸肩主要表示肩胛上提任务；它不能替代水平拉对中下斜方肌和肩胛后缩的覆盖。
movement_patterns.limitations: The atlas does not infer upper-trapezius need from posture or symptoms.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 旋后握与中立握属于不同变式；动作可用于增加直接肘屈覆盖，但并非所有计划都必须加入。
movement_patterns.limitations: Evidence comparing isolation and compound exercises is limited and population-specific.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 下压、过顶伸展和仰卧臂屈伸属于同一家族的不同关节设置；可系统变化，但不频繁随机轮换。
movement_patterns.limitations: Long-head emphasis is plausible but individual regional hypertrophy is not predicted.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 高脚杯深蹲、杠铃深蹲和腿举可按技术与器械选择；它们不是相同力量测试，但都可承担膝主导覆盖。
movement_patterns.limitations: Joint demands and range differ substantially; no universal squat depth or stance is prescribed.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 分腿蹲和弓步提供单侧训练任务；它们是可选覆盖方式，不被宣传为自动修复左右差异。
movement_patterns.limitations: No movement-screen diagnosis or asymmetry correction is inferred.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 腿屈伸提供直接膝伸覆盖，可与蹲类互补；系统不把它设为每个计划的强制动作。
movement_patterns.limitations: One machine setup does not represent all knee-extension devices or individual joint tolerance.

joint_actions: hip extension with controlled hip flexion
movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 罗马尼亚硬拉和直腿硬拉都属于髋铰链家族；先固定技术与动作幅度，再比较训练记录。
movement_patterns.limitations: The atlas does not assess lumbar symptoms or prescribe range of motion for an individual.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 腿弯举补充髋铰链没有直接表达的屈膝任务；器械设置变化时应重新建立训练基线。
movement_patterns.limitations: Exercise setup can change muscle length; no universal regional-growth advantage is asserted.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 臀桥家族提供髋伸覆盖，可根据器械从自重过渡到外部负荷；不把臀桥与髋铰链视为同一刺激。
movement_patterns.limitations: The catalogue label does not establish superiority for gluteal hypertrophy.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 外展和内收是相反动作，应分别记录；是否加入直接动作由训练目标和整体覆盖决定。
movement_patterns.limitations: This family is not a hip stability screen or rehabilitation recommendation.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 保留直膝和屈膝设置，并在复训时维持相同站位、支撑和动作范围。
movement_patterns.limitations: No claim is made that one knee position completely isolates one calf muscle.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 卷腹家族记录主动躯干屈曲，与稳定类动作分开；动作库不判断腰痛人群适用性。
movement_patterns.limitations: No spinal-health or spot-reduction claim is supported.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 死虫、Pallof press 和侧桥代表不同稳定任务；不把坚持时间直接换算为增肌分数。
movement_patterns.limitations: These categories do not diagnose core weakness or prescribe rehabilitation.

movement_patterns.selection_notes_zh: 腕屈与腕伸分别记录；上游动作库缺少完整握持分类，因此这一家族标记为内容覆盖有限。
movement_patterns.limitations: Representative exercises do not cover all grip types or loaded carries.
